analysis_method: Read-only dnfile/dncil managed CIL plus original serialized bundle data. Original client not run. REA budget-limited earlier; not represented as a complete REA decompilation.
scope: Current ordinary hero/minion damage, heal sign, repeated hits and minion fatal presentation. No whole HUD or hero end-game sequence inferred.

entry.value: metadata.Data, negated for heal type2; full metadata amount rather than HP delta clamped at0
entry.activate: Spell.ActivateState(Action=3), even if already in Action; Spell.ChangeStateImpl does not early-return for same state
entry.hp_refresh: Card.OnSpellFinished_UpdateActorComponents0x06012dc8 -> Card.UpdateActorComponents0x06012ddd. Does not execute rules damage again.

assets.hero_binding: Card_Play_Hero_SpellTable.prefab:c7908ae61ab34412aa7f5a9bf3c89cf2; actual HERO_08/HERO_07 CardDefs have no SpellTable override

attachment.meaning: Follow owning actor transform during attack contact/return. Never freeze at world impact position or reassign to next surviving unit. Preserve source prefab root offset rather than generic root-zero asset placement.
attachment.concurrency: One persistent type7 instance per actor; a new hit cancels previous async and root tweens, restores alpha1, rewrites amount, and restarts. Different actors remain independent.

strings.crit_threshold: No amount threshold in DamageSplat; crit is supplied by metadata type23. Do not infer crit from damage>=N.

animation.fade_ease: linear enum21 explicitly inserted by iTween.ColorTo if absent, not global default easeOutExpo
animation.fade_targets: ROOT ColorTo includechildren defaulttrue, recursive child renderers/material colors; direct UberText uses TextColor
animation.after_wait: Disable all seven splat renderers, then OnStateFinished if activeState!=None
animation.movement: No upward float or position tween in DamageSplat async. Root scale and fade only.
animation.yield_precision: Update yield is a player-loop scheduling point, not a fixed duration or guaranteed complete frame. Delay uses scaled time and Update timing.

font.character_size_formula: serialized7.789999961853027 * FontDefinition.characterModifier1 *0.01, then resize-to-fit, then unboundModifiers1

resize_to_fit.algorithm: Measure unparented scale1 rotationidentity TextMesh bounds. For one line set lineSpacing0 while measuring; initial height subtracts (height(|\n|)-2*height(|)); while too large multiply charSize by0.95, clamp min0.01; subsequent measures use full bounds. Restore original transform/text/lineSpacing1. Does not lower fontSize80.

font.alignment: UberText Alignment1 center + Anchor1 middle => Unity.TextAnchor4 MiddleCenter

material.selection: UberTextMaterialManager.CreateUberTextMaterial0x06000137 querytype1; richText true; Locale zhCN9 != thTH15. NoVertColor only richTextfalse; _2pass onlythTH15; bold has separate query, ordinary -N strings never setHasBoldText.
material.shader_formula: Use recovered actual Shader29 and decoded blob from resource worker. Do not substitute font GUI/Text material, card RTT nine-sample shader, or guessed Gaussian outline.

death.body_hide: type5 Birth+.5s hides RootObject renderers recursively, not Actor/Spells sibling
death.actor_release: type5 None after nominal3.5s fires state-finished callback while activeStatealready0; Card.OnSpellStateFinished_DestroyActor0x06012dca destroys owningActor -> releaseallspells
death.server_order_boundary: Original death origin is Play-to-Graveyard processing, not a guessed relative offset after damage or attack return. 5834 adapter must preserve its existing death-wave/RNG/rule order and disclose presentation-event alignment.

flash_and_shake.damage_splat: No independent generic red hit flash or screen-shake call in DamageSplat path. Do not label legacy redflash as recovered source.
flash_and_shake.actor_state_refresh: Actor.OnSpellStateStarted -> ActorStateMgr.RefreshStateMgr0x0601489e merely marks HighlightState dirty; not a hurt-flash primitive.
flash_and_shake.board_damage_event: BoardEvents.DamageEvent0x06012c95 queues event data; no direct visual flash or shake.
flash_and_shake.attack_hit: Recovered AllyAttack_IMPACT_Hit clip has rotation tracks, no material-color flash. Attack impact prefab has its own CameraShaker/event chain already recovered in v32; separate from DamageSplat.
flash_and_shake.limits: This is evidence for inspected current path, not a claim that no other original effect anywhere has a hit flash.

remaining_native_boundary: Unity dynamic font atlas packing and glyph mesh generation / Renderer.bounds are native. Use the authorized offline Unity probe with actual GLEI00M_t_Outline and fontSize80 to reproduce glyph metrics/atlas/resize, not an arbitrary font substitute.
Original server packet timing between damage metadata and Play-to-Graveyard cannot be recovered from static client CIL alone.
Full minion death fragment/material-transition rendering and hero end-game death are outside this limited damage-UI implementation; exact bodyhide/release gates are recovered.
